build_runner_from_cfg: build a runner instance from a config dict using build_runner with default arguments
build_runner_constructor_from_cfg: build a runner constructor from a config dict using the RUNNER_BUILDERS registry
register_runner: register a new runner class in the RUNNERS registry for later instantiation
register_runner_builder: register a new runner builder class in the RUNNER_BUILDERS registry for custom construction
review_build_runner: review the build_runner function to understand how it extracts constructor type and instantiates runners
